The x-coordinates are staggered to avoid vertical alignments, creating a perturbed grid. The minimum area is limited by collinear or nearly collinear points on the left edge: (0,0), (0,1/4), (0,3/4), (0,1) form a line, so any adjacent pair plus a nearby point yields an area of 1/4 * dx / 2.
